# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 36 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** God's Judgment on Adam: Mercy

---

**36:1** God said to Adam: 'I have forgiven you, for I am the Lord your God who made you from the earth.'

**36:2** 'In my mercy I will give you rest from all toil and pain.'

**36:3** Adam said: 'Lord, I thank you for your great mercy. Blessed is your holy name forever.'

---
